articles.title: Twelve killed in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
articles.description: Another 309 people are injured in the attack on the airport, which come days after Yemen's Houthis said they had struck it.

articles.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
articles.description: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.

articles.title: Man dies after tiger attack at wildlife park
articles.description: It was reported the man entered the tiger enclosure at the attraction near Doncaster, police say.

articles.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
articles.description: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.
